patterns.note: An aggressive, high-saturation yellow dominates the visual landscape, serving as both a background canvas and a high-impact transition element.
A stark juxtaposition of clean, authoritative Swiss neo-grotesque typography with raw, casual handwritten annotations and scribbles.
Full-screen solid color wipes overtake the viewport during scroll transitions, creating a bold, rhythmic pacing between content blocks.
Brutalist-inspired grid layouts with extreme scale contrasts, featuring massive display headers alongside dense, multi-column project lists.

technique_notes: Recreate the scroll-wipe transition by pinning sections and using a scroll-linked animation library to scale a solid yellow overlay to 100vh/100vw before revealing the subsequent section.
Achieve the raw editorial aesthetic by layering transparent SVG handwritten text paths absolutely over a rigid CSS grid layout, ensuring they scale proportionally with the viewport.
Implement a dark-to-light theme toggle or section-based color shifting that seamlessly swaps global CSS custom properties for background and text colors as the user crosses scroll thresholds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extreme scale contrast with massive, heavy display headings and small, highly structured metadata and body text.

standout: The design stands out through its unapologetic use of a blindingly vibrant yellow as a full-screen structural element, combined with raw handwritten scribbles and a recurring pug motif. This subverts traditional corporate agency seriousness in favor of a bold, memorable identity.
